original_prompt: Put the cube then the banana in the bowl
clarified_prompt: Put the cube in the bowl then put the banana in the bowl
correction_unit: One distinct nominal scene/noise episode pair: original fails strict final task, clarification succeeds, and failed original has a deterministic early-release decision. One original observation is used per pair. This is one task and instruction pair, not a new independent goal per episode.

collection.selection: First eligible pairs in ascending slot order; stop at first complete paired block reaching 12 or at 48 pairs. Preserve every attempted pair and rejection reason.

edit.joint: Historical pooled-key recipe: average keys and residual-increment targets over distinct correction episodes, then one 72-row ridge solve per layer.

unseen_prompts: Place the cube in the bowl, followed by the banana.
evaluation.competing_prompt: Put the banana in the bowl then put the cube in the bowl
evaluation.freeze_requirement: Exact candidate, full test plan, runtime, and scoring identities must be sealed before held-out evaluation. No candidate or N selected from test outcomes.
evaluation.description: Changed arrangements swap cube and banana x positions in half the layouts and shift the bowl x position 4–6cm in every layout; independent fixed small jitter. Reset gates must validate positions, stability, and initially false goal.
evaluation.near_seed_role: Independent development selection layouts; not held-out.

limitations: One previously studied task and instruction pair; 12 episode corrections do not mean 12 independent goals.
Eligibility uses development outcomes and an early-release heuristic; no object-contact semantic claim is inferred from gripper state alone.
Nominal scene/noise pairing is not pixel-identical simulator counterfactual pairing.
The correction count excludes collection failures and rejected pairs; report both accepted corrections and all collection cost.
Full-trajectory LoRA has more state/action supervision than one-decision edits; compare common source episodes and disclose actual chunk counts.
Gradient-free closed-form fitting still uses observations and a human-supplied clarification.

lora.selection: Strict original-request success on separate development layouts; ties choose smaller learning rate. All final checkpoints fixed before held-out evaluation.
lora.source_unit: All predicted native physical action chunks along each successfully clarified source trajectory. These are policy self-demonstration action chunks, not measured robot joint trajectories.
